title: Surface-tension-induced high packing density carbon nanoribbon films with ultrahigh volumetric capacitance
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,10413-10424
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02047F, Paper
Xiaojun Shi, Huanwen Wang, Taoqiu Zhang, Tong Xue, Haiyong He, Hong Jin Fan
The internal hollow voids of tubular carbon fibers are eliminated due to the surface-tension-induced structural shrinkage, leading to high porosity and dense stacking. The obtained electrodes are suitable for ultrafast-charging supercapacitors.
